definitions.explanation: A formal or earnest request for something to be done. Stronger and more formal than お{願|ねが}い, often used when making requests to authorities, organizations, or in official contexts.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}の{要望|ようぼう}に{応|こた}える。
{要望|ようぼう}{書|しょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
{住民|じゅうみん}から{騒音|そうおん}{対策|たいさく}の{要望|ようぼう}が{多数|たすう}{寄|よ}せられたため、{市|し}は{調査|ちょうさ}に{乗|の}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Because numerous requests for noise countermeasures were received from residents, the city launched an investigation.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
{要望|ようぼう} is a formal word typically used when requesting something from an organization, government, or person in authority. It implies a strong, earnest desire and is more formal and weighty than {依頼|いらい} (commission/request) or お{願|ねが}い (request/favor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要望|ようぼう}に{応|こた}える (respond to a request)
- {要望|ようぼう}を{出|だ}す (put forward a request)
- {要望|ようぼう}{書|しょ} (written request, petition)
- {要望|ようぼう}が{多|おお}い (many requests)
- {要望|ようぼう}を{受|う}ける (receive a request)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {要求|ようきゅう}: demand (stronger, more insistent)
- {依頼|いらい}: request, commission (asking someone to do something)
- {要請|ようせい}: request, appeal (formal, often from one organization to another)
